تصطدمن (form VIII)
# تَصْطَدِمْنَ (taṣṭadimna) /tasˤ.tˤa.dim.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
# تُصْطَدَمْنَ (tuṣṭadamna) /tusˤ.tˤa.dam.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
